newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling unchanged against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling unchanged against dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling remained unchanged against the dollar but gained on sterling, the central Bank of Tanzania said on Friday.

Recovering some ground after almost one month of depreciation, the shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 624.6900 to the dollar. Last Friday the shilling exchanged at a rate of 625.1850 to the dollar and one month ago, 608.0283.
Against the pound, the shilling exchanged for 1018.4649 compared with Thursday's 1020.0266.
Dealers said the shilling's depreciation appeared to have stabilised and the market was comfortable with an exchange rate of 610-630 Tsh to the dollar.

"The shilling has been stable for the past three or four days. Some export proceeds are flowing in and if this trend continues we expect the dollar will depreciate further," said one dealer who asked not to be named.
